sources.title: BlockFusion wins approval to reopen bitcoin mine on Frontier Avenue

profile.research_note: Session 2026-09-03: local press names the operating entity "Northeast Data LLC" doing business as BlockFusion. All 10 OSM nodes for this name sit within ~250m of each other on the same Frontier Avenue industrial site and resolve to the same address via Nominatim reverse geocode; treated as one multi-building campus, not 10 distinct facilities.

reading.body:
BlockFusion Niagara Falls is a multi-building campus on Frontier Avenue consolidating ten mapped facilities into a single operating site, verified as of September 2026. The campus has published no megawatt figure for IT load, power delivery capacity, or PUE rating. A local news source from 2026 identifies the operating entity as Northeast Data LLC doing business as BlockFusion and describes the site's prior use as a bitcoin mining facility that was being reopened.

New York State has 31 mapped data center facilities, of which only one has published its power capacity to this site, totaling 3 MW. BlockFusion Niagara Falls ranks second in the state by published megawatts, which means it publishes less than the single facility that publishes more. Without a published power figure, the campus cannot be sized or positioned in the hierarchy of AI-relevant infrastructure. The state's lack of published capacity data makes even this relative ranking uninformative about actual scale.

The reversion to bitcoin mining history and the absence of any published power, cooling, or electrical specification means this campus cannot be evaluated against the hypothesis that grid constraint limits AI scaling. Readers assessing whether this site matters to AI infrastructure would need to find published technical specifications or operator statements about current power capacity and intended use before determining its relevance.
